events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and rebellious spirit continue to define rock and roll. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock N Roll Star
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite tune from the Burnage bard?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released (1971)
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine', featuring the iconic title track, was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song with a message that still resonates globally. What does it mean to you?

events.title: First Apple iPod released (2001)
events.blurb: The original Apple iPod, which revolutionised how we listen to music, was first introduced on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple dropped a device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, which Bond film or song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring spirit and musical genius of John Lennon. His message of peace continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental and sprawling double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary Record
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A truly groundbreaking and diverse collection of songs. Which track is your hidden gem?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death (1991)
events.blurb: Remembering Freddie Mercury, the iconic Queen frontman, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul', marking a significant artistic shift for the band, was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Pivotal Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and showcased their evolving sound. What's your top track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death (1980)
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his timeless message of peace, love, and understanding. His music lives on.
